Working notes (REQ-2406–2415)

Task: assign requests to desk A (standard queue), B (priority desk), or C (regional office).

Observed rules:
- C was accepted only for east-region large requests: large claim east (REQ-2413), large invoice east (REQ-2414).
- C was rejected for: large refund south, small shipment north, small claim east, large invoice north, large shipment north. So C is not general regional routing; likely valid only when region=east AND size=large.
- B was rejected for: large claim south, large refund east, large claim east. No accepted B yet. Avoid B unless new evidence appears.
- A has not been tried/confirmed. If C/B are invalid, A may be the default fallback, but this is unverified.

Useful cues:
- Region + size matter more than request type or phrases like “second attempt,” “client asking twice,” or “came in through regional office.”
- East + large is the only confirmed C case so far.
- Small item (even east) rejected C.
- North large rejected C.

Data caution:
- Some rejected records say “option C is not valid” even when B was attempted. Trust the attempted option and accepted/rejected outcome over the explanatory text.

Next decision policy:
- For east + large: prefer C (confirmed for claim/invoice; test shipment/refund).
- For all other combinations: do not use C. Do not use B without new positive evidence; consider A as likely fallback if allowed.
- Keep tracking whether C applies to east large shipment/refund, and whether B ever succeeds.

Working notes (REQ-2406–2425)

Task: assign requests to A (standard), B (priority), or C (regional).

Confirmed:
- C accepted only for east + large: claim (2413), invoice (2414). Still the only confirmed C pattern. Test east large shipment/refund.
- A accepted for small claim south (2418). So A is not a universal fallback.

Negative evidence:
- C rejected for: large refund south, small shipment north, small claim east, large invoice north, large shipment north, large shipment south (2416), small shipment east (2417), small shipment south (2419), small claim north (2420).
- B rejected for: large claim south, large refund east, large claim east, small refund east (2421). No accepted B yet. Avoid B unless positive evidence appears.
- A rejected for: large claim south (2422), small invoice east (2423), large refund north (2424), large shipment north (2425); also many earlier A attempts, including large/small shipments, small claim north, small refund east. A valid so far only small claim south.

Cues:
- Region + size matter. Phrases like “second attempt,” “same as last month,” “scanned not typed,” or “no rush” are distractors.
- Some rejection text names C/B even when A was attempted. Trust the attempted option plus accepted/rejected outcome over explanatory text.

Next policy:
- east + large: prefer C for claim/invoice; test shipment/refund.
- south + small + claim: use A.
- Other combinations: C generally invalid; B unconfirmed/invalid so far. A is not a general fallback. Track any new accepted B or A cases.

Working notes (REQ-2406–2435)

Task: assign requests to A (standard), B (priority), or C (regional).

Confirmed:
- C accepted: east + large claim (2413), east + large invoice (2414), east + small invoice (2427). So east invoice likely C regardless size; east large claim C.
- B accepted: north + large invoice (2430). First confirmed B.
- A accepted: south + small claim (2418, 2433).

Negative:
- C rejected: east small claim, east small shipment (2417, 2431), south large claim (2426), south large refund/shipment, south small shipment, north large invoice/shipment. C not general.
- B rejected: large claim south/east/north (2429, 2432), large refund east, small refund east, small invoice north (2434), large invoice south (2435). B only confirmed north large invoice.
- A rejected: large claim south (2422, 2426), small invoice east (2423), large refund north (2424), large shipment north (2425), small shipment east (2428, 2431), plus earlier. A only confirmed south small claim.

Cues:
- Region + size matter. Distractor phrases: “second attempt,” “same as last month,” “scanned not typed,” “no rush,” “twice already,” “before end of day.”
- Rejection text may name other options; trust attempted option + outcome.

Next policy:
- east + invoice: C. east + large claim: C. Test east large shipment/refund.
- north + large invoice: B. Test other B.
- south + small claim: A.
- Other combos: no confirmed rule; avoid A/B/C unless pattern matches. Track new accepted B/A/C.

Working notes (REQ-2406–2445)

Task: assign requests to A (standard), B (priority), or C (regional).

Confirmed:
- C: east + large invoice (2414, 2437); east + large claim (2413); east + large shipment (2441). East invoice likely C regardless size.
- B: north + large invoice (2430) only.
- A: earlier south + small claim (2418, 2433), but REQ-2439 south small claim rejected A. Treat A for south small claim as unreliable.
- Anomalous accepted: north small refund (2436) and east small shipment (2440) accepted only when D was attempted; D is not valid elsewhere. Do not infer A/B/C from D.

Rejected:
- C: east small claim (2417), east small shipment (2431), south large claim (2426); C not general.
- B: large claims/refunds across regions; north small invoice (2434); south large invoice (2435); south small invoice (2438). B only confirmed north large invoice.
- A: south large claim (2422, 2426, 2445); small invoice east (2423); large refund/shipment north (2424, 2425); small shipment east (2428, 2431); south small claim now rejected (2439). A only old south small claim.

Cues:
- Region + size matter. Ignore distractor phrases: “no rush,” “scanned not typed,” “same as last month,” “twice already,” etc.
- Rejection text may name other invalid options; trust attempted option + outcome.

Next policy:
- east + invoice/large claim/large shipment: C.
- north + large invoice: B.
- south + small claim: not A; no confirmed rule.
- Other combos: avoid A/B/C unless pattern matches. Track new accepted B/A/C.

Working notes (REQ-2406–2455)

Task: assign to A standard, B priority, C regional.

Trust attempted option + score. Rejection text may name another option; do not let it override.

Confirmed/accepted:
- C: east + large shipment (2441) only.
- B: north + large invoice (2430) only.
- D anomaly: north + small refund (2436, 2454) accepted when D attempted. D invalid elsewhere; do not infer A/B/C from D.

New contradictions/corrections:
- Earlier C for east large invoice (2414, 2437) contradicted by 2447: C attempted, +0.00. Drop C for east invoice.
- Earlier C for east large claim (2413) contradicted by 2450 and 2455: C attempted, +0.00. Drop C for east large claim.
- C also rejected for east large refund (2451, C +0.00).
- A rejected for south small invoice (2448, A +0.00). South small claim was already unreliable/rejected (2439). Do not use A.
- C rejected previously for east small claim/shipment, south large claim. C not general.
- B rejected for most claims/refunds/invoices except north large invoice.

Cues:
- Region + size matter. Ignore distractor phrases (“no rush,” “scanned not typed,” “same as last month,” “twice already,” “regional office,” etc.).
- Rejection text may name invalid options; trust attempted option + outcome.
- D only for north small refund; other D attempts rejected.

Next policy:
- east + large shipment: C.
- north + large invoice: B.
- north + small refund: D only if D is allowed; otherwise avoid A/B/C.
- All other combos: avoid A/B/C unless a new accepted match appears. Track accepted A/B/C/D by region + type + size.

Working notes (REQ-2406–2459)

Task: assign A standard, B priority, C regional. Trust attempted option + score. Ignore option named in rejection text.

Confirmed accepted:
- C: east + large shipment only (2441).
- B: north + large invoice only (2430).
- D anomaly: north + small refund (2436, 2454) accepted when D attempted. D invalid elsewhere; do not infer A/B/C.
- A: south + large claim? REQ-2459 accepted with A (53, 58) but same ticket also A rejected (57, 59). Unreliable; do not treat as confirmed.

Rejected/corrections:
- C invalid for east large invoice (2447), east large claim (2450, 2455), east large refund (2451), east small refund (2456); also east small claim/shipment, south large claim. Drop C except east large shipment.
- A invalid for east large invoice (2457, A +0.00), south small invoice (2448). South small claim already unreliable.
- D invalid for north large shipment (2458); D only north small refund.
- B only north large invoice; rejected for most other claims/refunds/invoices.

Cues:
- Region + type + size matter. Ignore “no rush,” “scanned not typed,” “same as last month,” “twice already,” “regional office,” “second attempt,” etc.
- Rejection text may name other options; use attempted option and outcome.

Next policy:
- east + large shipment: C.
- north + large invoice: B.
- north + small refund: D only if D allowed; otherwise avoid A/B/C.
- All other combos: avoid A/B/C/D unless a new consistent accepted match appears. Track by region + type + size.
